method: Generated glow RGB and alpha, identity canvas; source-emitter color masks and registered ROI crops, 2 px triangular feather, attenuated alpha. No procedural RGB or base repaint.

tiles.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: registered emissive overlay for a cosy painted isometric game tile, not a replacement tile.
Input image 1 is the exact edit target. Output a separate glow-only layer with true transparent alpha, same 1024 x 1536 portrait canvas and pixel registration as image 1. Keep the existing image framing, scale and positions absolutely fixed. Do not center, resize, recrop or rearrange any feature. Do not paint the building, slab, plants, pipes, metallic frames or ground: all those surfaces must become fully transparent. Preserve only a very small, soft, low-intensity halo at the EXISTING painted light locations described below. The layer will be added using canvas lighter blend on top of the unchanged base; it must be gentle, not a neon redraw or bright white wash. Use soft dim teal/cyan and small warm lamp glow where the source already contains it. Black/transparent everywhere else, no opaque black background, no particles or stars, no new lights or objects, no geometry, no outlines, no text. Keep all illumination within x=32..992, y>=24 and above the original tile outline; leave the kerb and surrounding background transparent.
Specific allowed emitters: The central round reactor core and its two narrow side reactor columns, plus the small teal windows above and below the central circle. Main brightest area is only the small inner turquoise reactor orb, not the whole circular housing. Two small already-existing amber entry wall lamps can glow softly.
